{{Conjecture}}
This '''pirate gang''' was run by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jauxson]]. Although they began operations by preying on [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] traffic, Jauxson and his bandits eventually set up operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]. The group set up headquarters in the mountains near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Buerhoz]], raiding that city and two others every few weeks and protecting themselves from the harsh [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] with [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] and [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]].<ref name="AFOC 22-23">{{WEGCite|story=A Fistful of Credits|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen}}</ref> When a band of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] confronted the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in a [[Skirmish of Buerhoz|skirmish]], Jauxson's pirate gang was defeated, resulting in the deposition of Jauxston.<ref name="CSWE II 142">{{CSWECite|II|142|Jauxson}}</ref>
